saleValue: A fully charged spell can usually be sold for d6 x 100p in a settlement. A depleted spell is worth half.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.effect: Shoot a fireball up to 24". Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to all creatures within 6".
spells.recharge: Burn in the heart of a raging fire for three days and nights.

spells.name: Heal
spells.effect: Heal [SUM] STR damage and remove the Injured Condition from a creature.
spells.recharge: Cut self for d6 STR damage, sprinkle the spell with the blood.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.effect: Deal [SUM] + [DICE] damage to a creature within sight.
spells.recharge: Drop from a height of at least 30ft. Touch the spell within one Turn.

spells.name: Fear
spells.effect: Give the Frightened Condition to [DICE] creatures.
spells.recharge: Receive the Frightened Condition from a hostile creature while carrying the spell.

spells.name: Darkness
spells.effect: Create a [SUM] x 2" diameter sphere of pure darkness for [DICE] Turns.
spells.recharge: Leave uncovered in a lightless place for three days.

spells.name: Restore
spells.effect: Remove Exhausted or Frightened Condition from [DICE] + 1 creatures
spells.recharge: Bury in a peaceful field or riverbank for three days.

spells.name: Be Understood
spells.effect: Make your meaning clear to [DICE] creatures of another species for [DICE] Turns.
spells.recharge: Give away freely to a creature of another species.

spells.name: Ghost Beetle
spells.effect: Create an illusory beetle that can carry 6 inventory slots for [DICE] x 6 Turns.
spells.recharge: Bury in a beetle graveyard for three nights.

spells.name: Light
spells.effect: Force [DICE] creatures to make a WIL save or become stunned. Alternately, create light as bright as a torch for [SUM] turns.
spells.recharge: Catch in the first light of a sunrise and the last light of sunset for three days.

spells.name: Invisible Ring
spells.effect: Creates [DICE] x 6" ring of force. It is invisible and immovable. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
spells.recharge: Build an iron ring the same size as last cast. Pass the spell though it. Dissolves the ring.

spells.name: Knock
spells.effect: Open a door or container, as if a Save were made with STR score of 10 + [DICE] x 4.
spells.recharge: Put in a locked box, inside a locked box, inside a locked box. Leave for three days.

spells.name: Grease
spells.effect: Cover [DICE] x 6" area in slippery, flammable grease. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save or fall prone.
spells.recharge: Rub all over in animal fat. Leave until it putrefies.

spells.name: Grow
spells.effect: Grow a creature to [DICE] + 1 times its original size for 1 Turn.
spells.recharge: Leave in the highest branches of a tall tree for three days.

spells.name: Invisibility
spells.effect: Make creature invisible for [DICE] Turns. Any movement reduces duration by 1 Turn.
spells.recharge: Go a day without opening your eyes once, while holding the spell.

spells.name: Catnip
spells.effect: Turn object into an irresistible lure for cats. Lasts [DICE] Turns.
spells.recharge: Give a cat a gift it truly desires.
